subject: South Street Shipbuilding Historic District Boundaries
overview: The commission refined the boundaries of the proposed South Street Historic District and initiated a plan for historical inventory documentation. Members also established an outreach strategy for affected homeowners and scheduled a follow-up meeting to finalize design guidelines.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the February meeting.

items.title: South Street District Boundaries
items.summary: Amended the proposed South Street Historic District map by voting to exclude 12 Walnut Street.

items.title: Outreach Strategy and District Naming
items.summary: Discussed naming the area the South Street Shipbuilding Historic District and assigned members to develop a concrete outreach plan for the 18 property owners.

items.title: Historical Inventory Documentation
items.summary: Approved a motion to seek a quote from John Clemson to prepare Form B inventory forms for properties in the district currently lacking specific documentation.

items.title: Design Guidelines and Interim Meeting
items.summary: Delegated authority to the chair to approve consulting fees for a review of district design guidelines and scheduled an interim meeting for March 23.
